messages:
morgan: Heads-up — thinking through fallback behavior for multi-region hosted API. Goal: premium tenants get stronger region affinity and fewer variant downgrades; lower tiers more aggressive on cost fallbacks. Thoughts?
ana: +1 on affinity but we need a mechanism to measure transient vs sustained degradation. prefix probe windows? :eyes:
morgan: Exactly. Proposal: maintain short-window p95 latency and an error rate for region. If p95 > 250ms OR errors > 0.5% for 30s, start a staged fallback: 1) probe nearby region for 5% of traffic (tier-based), 2) if probe healthy, shift X% of non-premium to probe region, 3) only degrade model variant for requests where both primary+probe failing.
ira: Probe sampling is fine but beware cold-cache penalties. Probes should warm KV cache before considering region healthy. Maybe send a synthetic warmup for probes?
morgan: Good call. Add warmup tokens: send 2 synthetic short requests for top prompt prefixes per model variant during probe init. We'll mark them as internal to avoid billing.
sam: From product side — premium tenants should be able to opt into cross-region failover or disable it for data residency. We need a simple toggle in Console with clear SLA/latency notes.
tasha: For rollout UX: add an explanatory tooltip: "Cross-region failover increases availability but may route to non-local data centers; disable if residency required." Keep it default-on for premium, default-off for self-serve.
nana: Also propose telemetry: add route_histogram by region+variant+tier and a probe_success_rate metric. Dashboard tile should show active probes and their success window. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ira: Quota implications: when we route to probe region, counts should be applied to origin tenant quotas and not double-count across regions. Also ensure dedicated pools don't get accidental burst from probes.
morgan: Agreed. Routing should carry tenant_id and billing_tag. Probes must be counted but labeled probe:true in telemetry. We can add a low-weight billing tag so cost attribution is correct.
sam: For policy config, something like this would be helpful in Console and API:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  affinity: REGION_PREFERRED
  probe_sample_by_tier:
    premium: 0.01
    standard: 0.05
    free: 0.1
  fallback_model_thresholds:
    latency_ms: 400
    error_pct: 1.0
```
nana: Looks good. One more: probe backoff — increase sample rate if primary continues to degrade, cap at 20% for standard/free, 5% for premium to avoid churn.
tasha: UX note — show live probe rate and how many requests were diverted in last 5m. Also actionable button to "force failover" for debugging.
morgan: Ops concerns: rolling failure scenarios where region A and B both degraded. We should prefer model-variant fallback over cross-region in that situation to avoid multi-region storms. Rule: try model fallback first if cross-region latency delta < 80ms.
ira: That rule helps. Also add circuit breaker: if probe_success_rate < 60% over 2 minutes, stop probing for 10m to avoid thrashing.
nana: replay-bot: probe-report for recent run -> region eu-west avg probe_success 98%, us-west 96%, ap-south 61% (rising).
replay-bot: {"probe_run_ts":"1939876500","details":"ap-south failing KV warmup, increased cold miss; next probe scheduled +2m"}
morgan: Thanks. Action items: ana to draft config PR for routing engine, ira to add circuit breaker metrics/alerts, tasha + sam to mock Console toggles and tooltip copy. I'll own probe warmup implementation.
sanity_check: anyone object to default probe sample rates above?
sam: ok from product.
tasha: ok from DX.
ira: ok from SRE.
nana: will open PR. :thumbsup: 
morgan: cool — we'll run a small canary with 5 tenants for 24h then evaluate telemetry and cost delta.
